title: The Lacoste Polo Shirt Seen on Stars Like Pharrell and Gavin Casalegno Is 63% Off With This Amazon Prime Day Deal
summary: Beloved by entertainers and athletes alike, the menswear staple starts at just $42 online.
contentText:

Lacoste polos are a staple among the stylish set, and the preppy collared shirt has been seen on everyone from Pharrell Williams to Joe Jonas over the years, not to mention actor and athlete ambassadors like Taylor Zakhar Perez and Novak Djokovic . The Summer I Turned Pretty’s Gavin Casalegno, meantime, was spotted at Lacoste’s Paris Fashion Week show last year.

Gavin Casalegno attends the Lacoste SS26 Fashion Show during Paris Fashion Week on October 5, 2025 in Paris, France.

Sam Simpson/Dave Benett/Getty Images

But the sportswear staple isn’t cheap. In fact, a Lacoste polo shirt typically runs you over $100 and that’s just for the plain, solid-color version. Striped or graphic Lacoste polos can sometimes cost up to $300 online.

That’s why we’re taking advantage of this Amazon Prime Big Deals Day offer , which gets you a brand new Lacoste polo from as low as $42 online . That’s a whopping 63% discount off the regular Amazon price of $115 and the lowest price we’ve seen for this menswear essential.

LOWEST PRICE ONLINE

Lacoste Men's Classic Fit Original Piqué Polo Shirt

$42.99 $115.00 63% off

Buy Now On Amazon

This Prime Day deal gets you the bestselling Lacoste pique polo shirt in your choice of 30+ colors and sizes XS to 4XL. This light blue color seen here is called “overview” according to the Amazon list.

At just $42, the polo shirt is even cheaper than ones we spotted during a recent visit to the Lacoste outlet, not to mention comparable to used Lacoste polos you’d find at a vintage store.

STOCK UP AND SAVE

$46.74 $115.00 59% off

This is another Lacoste polo under $50. This one shown here is a “khaki” colorway in a size medium.

CLASSIC COLORWAY

$56.99 $115.00 50% off

The Prime Big Deal Days offer applies to the classic fit version, which features a straight cut and trim (but not tight) silhouette.

The polo is made from Lacoste’s cotton piqué fabric, which has a textured feel and slightly ribbed finish on the collar and sleeves.

This is a two-button polo with Lacoste’s famous “pearl” buttons. The shirt is embroidered with the French brand’s iconic green crocodile on the left chest.

We’ve long been fans of the Lacoste polo shirt and own multiple colors, thanks to its incredible versatility. While Lacoste was inspired by tennis attire (or courtside attire, say, for Wimbledon ), you can also wear this shirt to the office, to dinner or just to class up a casual everyday look. The pique material is super breathable, while the tailoring of the shirt allows it to sit just off your body, rather than clinging tightly against it (I.e. no sweaty days here).

SHOP LACOSTE POLO DEALS ON AMAZON

Regularly $115+, Amazon has the Lacoste polo on sale from just $42. We suggest stocking up on multiple colors while the deal is live, as Lacoste polos are one of those core menswear items that never go on sale.

For comparison, Lacoste’s own website has the classic fit polo for $115 and up , so you’re saving a decent chunk of change by shopping on Amazon.
